import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
g=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(g); print(o)
# rule: two colored shapes same color; vertical band between them filled with 4 in columns where both shapes span? 
# demo: top shape cols1-3, bottom cols0-1; fill col... only col2? no output fills col1 rows1-3.
# top shape cells rows0 cols1,2,3; sep row4; bottom row8 cols0,1. fill col1 rows1..3 -> intersection of column sets is {1}. yes.
def f(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0]); out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    seps=[i for i,r in enumerate(gi) if r[0]!=0 and all(x==r[0] for x in r)]
    sep=gi[seps[0]][0]
    top=[(i,j) for i in range(seps[0]) for j,x in enumerate(gi[i]) if x!=0]
    bot=[(i,j) for i in range(seps[0]+1,len(gi)) for j,x in enumerate(gi[i]) if x!=0]
    inter={j for _,j in top}&{j for _,j in bot}
    lastA=max(i for i,_ in top); firstB=min(i for i,_ in bot)
    for j in inter:
        for i in range(lastA+1,firstB):
            out[i][j]=4
    return out
print(json.dumps(f(g))==json.dumps(o))
